content: ⌊ DRAFT g In case no Unit is given for the SwCluCBMan- ifResourceGuardValue calculation, the Cross Cluster Communication shall use the following attribute values: • Unit . factorSiToUnit = 1 • Unit . offsetSiToUnit = 0 • Unit . physicalDimension according to [SWS_SwCluC_03041] Additionally, the attributes of PhysicalDimension according to [SWS_SwCluC_03041] apply.
